summary: Apply data-quality, coverage and payment analysis to social protection decisions. Explore the 10-day course outline and enquire today.
lede: Big data analysis in social protection uses administrative, registry and payment records to inform programme decisions. For social protection analysts, registry specialists and programme managers, the course develops skills in assessing data quality, analysing coverage gaps and interpreting payment patterns, with structured workflows and responsible use of geospatial and predictive methods.
audienceIntro: The course is designed for professionals who work directly with social assistance data and need to use it responsibly in programme planning, delivery or oversight.
modules: Big Data in Social Protection Delivery
prerequisites: Working knowledge of social protection programmes, administrative data or programme monitoring is recommended. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful. Coding is not required; machine-learning and scalable-data topics are treated at operational or conceptual level rather than as programming labs.
